title: Describe a problem so others can help

captions.text: “It doesn't work” hardly helps support. Whoever is meant to help has to be able to reproduce the fault.

scenes.title: Describe the steps up to the fault. And say what should actually ha…

captions.text: Describe the steps up to the fault. And say what should actually have happened.

scenes.title: Copy the error message word for word, with the code. Support finds …

captions.text: Copy the error message word for word, with the code. Support finds “PW-412” at once, “some error” not.
A short pause to think: What is the best way to pass on an error message?

scenes.title: Finally: what have you already tried? And which device and browser …

captions.text: Finally: what have you already tried? And which device and browser do you use?
A short pause to think: What is missing here? “I wanted to save the report as a PDF. After Export → PDF, error PW-412 appeared. Reloading didn't help.”
